_comment: Known type errors in supabase/functions, produced by `tsrs` over every TypeScript file. `__tests__/typecheck-baseline.test.ts` fails if an error appears that is not here, and fails if one here no longer occurs, so this file can only shrink. The budget is now empty: the last entry (the external metrics RPC) was fixed at the typed-client boundary. The test's premise guard checks the client factories and generated schema directly instead of requiring a residual error.
